documentation.important: Synthetic placeholders are prefixed REPLACE_ME and submission rejects them. Copy this file to registration-data.json, replace every REPLACE_ME value using current AWS field definitions, and never commit registration-data.json or attachments/.
documentation.campaignStatus: SCHEMA-ONLY AND BLOCKED: AWS currently says emergency-alert traffic is not permitted through A2P 10DLC. The script rejects every campaign submission before AWS access. Never relabel actual PSD EOC incident or drill traffic as education, government, or another use case. Use toll-free unless written provider guidance and a reviewed code change explicitly re-enable 10DLC.
